_about: Shared calendar facts for the application cycle. Edit this file when a date moves — no Python changes needed. The rules for *computing* dates (which aid year a deadline belongs to, how a late start compresses) live in scripts/make_tracker.py, because prose instructions get re-derived and re-derived date arithmetic is how you get a nine-month error nobody notices.
_maintenance: Verify the aid dates each summer before the cycle starts. The _note fields are read by the skills and surfaced to students, so keep them accurate rather than decorative.

aid.fafsa_note: Historically Oct 1. Moved to Dec 31 for the 2024-25 cycle during FAFSA simplification, then back toward Oct 1. Verify before each cycle — this one moves more than anything else here.
aid.css_note: Only some colleges require the CSS Profile. Check each school before telling a family to file it.

rules.spring_cutoff_note: A deadline in January through June belongs to the aid cycle that opened the PREVIOUS October — the student matriculates that fall. Deadlines in July through December belong to the cycle opening that same October.
rules.runway_note: The backward plan assumes 10 weeks. A shorter runway compresses the sequence proportionally rather than generating overdue tasks.

backward_plan.task: Send brag sheet + resume to each recommender
Confirm test score send (if submitting scores)
Pay fee or submit fee waiver

profile_tasks.task: Finalize balanced list: 2+ true safeties you'd be happy at

key_dates_defaults.notes: Register ~5 weeks ahead. Last useful date is usually October of senior year.
Historically Oct 1 — verify, it has moved. File as early as you can.
May 1. Deposit at exactly one school.
